stats.text:
Whenever you finish a {ref:glossary/long-rest}, choose one type of land: arid, polar, temperate, or tropical. Consult the table below that corresponds to the chosen type; you have the spells listed for your Druid level and lower prepared.

**Arid Land**

| Druid Level | Circle Spells |
|---|---|
| 3 | *{ref:spell/blur}*, *{ref:spell/burning-hands}*, *{ref:spell/fire-bolt}* |
| 5 | *{ref:spell/fireball}* |
| 7 | *{ref:spell/blight}* |
| 9 | *{ref:spell/wall-of-stone}* |

**Polar Land**

| Druid Level | Circle Spells |
|---|---|
| 3 | *{ref:spell/fog-cloud}*, *{ref:spell/hold-person}*, *{ref:spell/ray-of-frost}* |
| 5 | *{ref:spell/sleet-storm}* |
| 7 | *{ref:spell/ice-storm}* |
| 9 | *{ref:spell/cone-of-cold}* |

**Temperate Land**

| Druid Level | Circle Spells |
|---|---|
| 3 | *{ref:spell/misty-step}*, *{ref:spell/shocking-grasp}*, *{ref:spell/sleep}* |
| 5 | *{ref:spell/lightning-bolt}* |
| 7 | *{ref:spell/freedom-of-movement}* |
| 9 | *{ref:spell/tree-stride}* |

**Tropical Land**

| Druid Level | Circle Spells |
|---|---|
| 3 | *{ref:spell/acid-splash}*, *{ref:spell/ray-of-sickness}*, *{ref:spell/web}* |
| 5 | *{ref:spell/stinking-cloud}* |
| 7 | *{ref:spell/polymorph}* |
| 9 | *{ref:spell/insect-plague}* |
